name: simulation_summarise
description: Take a simulation output bundle (NetCDF/HDF5/CSV + metadata), produce a plain-language summary, KPIs, and follow-up experiments.

parameters.name: artifact_id
parameters.description: A2L artifact ID for the simulation output bundle.

parameters.name: kpis
parameters.description: Optional list of named KPIs to extract.

args.system: Extract the requested KPIs from the metadata; missing KPIs should be returned as null. Output JSON.
Write a plain-language summary tailored to a {{audience}}. Include the KPIs and 2-3 follow-up experiments worth running.
